questions.question: Which of the following peaks of the Himalayas in India has a height more than the Nanga Parbat peak?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Kanchenjunga) है।

questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding Fundamental Duties and select the correct option.A. Fundamental Duties are part of the Indian Constitution.B. Fundamental Duties can be enforced through writ jurisdiction.
options: B is correct but A is not
Both A and B are correct
Neither A nor B is correct
A is correct but B is not
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (A is correct but B is not) है।

questions.question: Which instrument is NOT typically associated with Kathak music?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Mridangam) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT part of the nutritional care process during illness?
options: Monitoring and evaluating nutritional care outcomes
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Ignoring nutritional needs) है।

questions.question: Which of the following great warriors and administrators established a kingdom in the north?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Harshavardhana) है।

questions.question: How many total gold medals were secured by India in the Paris Paralympics, 2024?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (7) है।

questions.question: Which of the following marketing channels belongs to Andhra Pradesh, established in the year 1999, to facilitate direct marketing between consumers and farmers?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Rythu Bazars) है।

questions.question: How has liberalisation affected trade policies in India since the 1990s reforms?
options: By removing trade barriers and encouraging foreign investment
By increasing tariffs on all imports
By focussing only on domestic markets
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (By removing trade barriers and encouraging foreign investment) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the relationship between globalisation and the movement of goods and services?
options: Globalisation only affects the movement of services, not goods.
Globalisation restricts the movement of goods and services.
Globalisation facilitates the movement of goods and services across borders.
Globalisation has no impact on the movement of goods and services.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Globalisation facilitates the movement of goods and services across borders.) है।

questions.question: The Bombay High Court has jurisdiction of which of the following two union territories?
options: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements with respect to National Green Hydrogen Mission in India is NOT correct?1. This mission aims to achieve a targeted production capacity of 50 million tonnes per annum of Green Hydrogen by 2030.2.The nodal ministry of the scheme is Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (1 only) है।

questions.question: Who won the 2025 FIDE Women's Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Koneru Humpy) है।

questions.question: Which of the following leaders is associated with the Extremist Phase of the Indian National Movement?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Bal Gangadhar Tilak) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Public Accounts Committee is correct?
options: It performs pre-audit functions of government expenditure.
Its recommendations are binding on ministries.
It examines policy decisions made by the government.
It ensures that grants voted by Parliament are spent within the scope of the demand.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (It ensures that grants voted by Parliament are spent within the scope of the demand.) है।

questions.question: What does a switch do in an electric circuit?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Opens or closes the circuit) है।

questions.question: The Samarth Incubation Program has been initiated by which ministry of Government of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Ministry of Communication) है।

questions.question: What does CRR (Cash Reserve Ratio) refer to?
options: Percentage of net demand and time liabilities to be maintained by commercial banks with RBI
Portion of deposits banks must keep with themselves in cash
Percentage of cash held by the government
Rate of interest on savings accounts
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Percentage of net demand and time liabilities to be maintained by commercial banks with RBI) है।

questions.question: Which of the following roles do stomata play in photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Exchange gases) है।

questions.question: Which cell organelle contains the genetic material?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Nucleus) है।

questions.question: Who became the first captain in the world to lead his team in all four major ICC events in March 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Rohit Sharma) है।
